title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named University of Denver destinations for studying, meeting, services, recreation, and performances.

cards.title: Set up a group-study session at Anderson Academic Commons
cards.subtitle: Main library · 2150 E. Evans Ave.
cards.notes: Use the group study rooms or computers between classes, then consult the library’s floor map when you need a specific room or service.
cards.short_summary: DU’s main library combines collections, computers, academic support, and group-study space.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Denver identifies Anderson Academic Commons as its main library and says it provides group study rooms and computers.
cards.source_title: Living at DU | University of Denver
cards.access_notes: Library floor maps and room information are available through University Libraries.

cards.title: Meet up in the Community Commons
cards.subtitle: 2055 E. Evans Ave. · student activity hub
cards.notes: Use the communal spaces or reservable rooms for a planned meetup, and check the building page before relying on seasonal hours.
cards.short_summary: A four-floor campus hub with dining, gathering areas, student services, and event spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Affairs describes Community Commons as a central hub of student activity with dining, social spaces, reservable meeting rooms, and services.
cards.access_notes: Student Affairs posts building hours that vary by academic period and break.

cards.title: Use Driscoll Commons as a service stop
cards.subtitle: 2050 E. Evans Ave. · connected to Community Commons
cards.notes: Plan one practical errand here, such as an ID question, accessibility support, bookstore visit, or Food Pantry stop; confirm office availability first.
cards.short_summary: The connected commons building concentrates several student-facing services.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Affairs lists the DU Food Pantry, Pioneer ID Card Office, Student Disability Services, bookstore, and bank among Driscoll Commons services.
cards.access_notes: Individual offices and the bookstore maintain their own availability; consult the department listing before visiting.

cards.title: Take a breather in the Undergraduate Lounge
cards.subtitle: Community Commons 3600 · third floor
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a low-key pause between commitments, and treat the lounge as a shared student space rather than a reservable meeting room.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated third-floor respite and social space for undergraduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Affairs says the Undergraduate Lounge in Community Commons 3600 is for undergraduates to mingle, socialize, and connect.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Community Commons; intended for undergraduate students.

cards.title: Connect with peers in the Graduate Lounge
cards.subtitle: Community Commons 3800 · third floor
cards.notes: Use this graduate-focused lounge for a short reset or conversation with peers, keeping the space available for the wider graduate community.
cards.short_summary: A designated Community Commons space for graduate-student respite and connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Affairs identifies the Graduate Lounge in Community Commons 3800 as a place for graduate students to socialize and connect.
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of Community Commons; intended for graduate students.

cards.title: Locate the DU Food Pantry before you need it
cards.subtitle: Driscoll Commons, Garden Level, Suite 6
cards.notes: Save the suite location now, then visit the Food Pantry’s official page for eligibility, appointment, and current access information before going.
cards.short_summary: A named campus pantry located in Driscoll Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Affairs lists the DU Food Pantry on the Garden Level of Driscoll Commons in Suite 6.
cards.access_notes: Check the Food Pantry’s current program information before visiting.

cards.title: Put the Burwell Center on your career-planning route
cards.subtitle: 2190 E. Asbury Ave. · campus career destination
cards.notes: Use the campus-listed location as a waypoint when arranging career support, and confirm the relevant program or appointment details before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A named campus destination for career achievement services.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Denver’s campus map lists the Burwell Center for Career Achievement, and the registrar gives its address as 2190 E. Asbury Ave.
cards.access_notes: Use the Career Achievement office’s current instructions for appointments and service availability.

cards.entity_name: Newman Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Check the Newman Center calendar for a performance
cards.subtitle: 2344 E. Iliff Ave. · Lamont School of Music & Theatre
cards.notes: Browse the current Lamont calendar, then review the individual event’s ticketing details before heading to the Newman Center.
cards.short_summary: A campus performance venue that hosts Lamont School of Music & Theatre events.
cards.evidence_claim: DU identifies the Newman Center as the Lamont School of Music & Theatre location and directs visitors to its performance calendar and box office.
cards.source_title: Lamont School of Music & Theatre Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Some Lamont concerts are free while others are ticketed; verify the specific event before attending.

cards.entity_name: Daniel L. Ritchie Center for Sports and Wellness
cards.title: Make the Ritchie Center part of an active day
cards.subtitle: 2201 E. Asbury Ave. · sports and wellness facility
cards.notes: Use the official campus map to orient yourself, then check the relevant recreation, club-sport, or event information before planning your visit.
cards.short_summary: A named campus facility associated with sports, wellness, club sports, and intramurals.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Denver’s campus resources identify the Ritchie Center in connection with Pioneer Athletics, Coors Fitness Center, club sports, and intramurals.
cards.access_notes: Programs, memberships, and event access may have separate requirements; consult the relevant Ritchie Center program page.

cards.title: Pause at Evans Chapel during a campus walk
cards.subtitle: University of Denver campus · map-listed chapel
cards.notes: Include the chapel as a quiet landmark on a walking route, and check campus event information if you intend to attend a scheduled program.
cards.short_summary: A named chapel and campus landmark on the University of Denver map.
cards.evidence_claim: University of Denver’s official campus map lists Evans Chapel as a campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Access may vary when the chapel is reserved or used for scheduled programs.
